steps.text: Captain {captain}! The Reach needs captains who can turn a profit without turning pirate. Carry this letter to the governor of {p1}. And bring a cargo of sugar: an empty hold makes a poor impression.
Carry the sealed letter to the governor of {p1}, with 10 Cane Sugar in the hold.
Load 10 Cane Sugar.
Deliver the letter to the governor of {p1}.
A letter of credit from my old colleague, and a trader who keeps their word. Here is your fee, and a word of warning: Grimmer's raiders are growing bolder.
Letter delivered. Spice traders now deal with you.
The barkeep in {p2} hears everything that floats. Find out who is feeding Grimmer his targets.
Talk to the barkeep in {p2}.
Grimmer's eyes are everywhere, love. Merchants who fight back get left alone. Sink one of his raiders and the word gets round.
Win a sea battle against a raider.
Saw your fight from the yardarm. If you want the Admiralty on your side, they need to see coin as well as cannon. Put some savings in a bank.
Hold 10,000 in any bank.
The Admiralty takes note. Musket contracts are open to you.
Captain {captain}. Dimas Crowe, of Crowe & Daughters. You have been selling under my prices. In the Reach we call that rude. Stay out of {p5}, and we'll stay friends.
Dimas Crowe warned you away from {p5}. Naturally, you are going there.
Break Crowe's grip: bring 20 Spice to {p5}.
Spice at an honest price! Crowe has been squeezing us for years. They say his books are kept by a clerk who drinks in {p6}.
steps.ok: Then I'll buy the clerk a drink.

steps.text: Find Crowe's clerk in the tavern at {p6}.
The clerk? Passed out in the corner, love. Left this behind. Looks like somebody's second set of books.
Grow your net worth to 45,000 while Crowe's prices collapse.
You've made your point, captain. Grimmer paid me to keep the honest traders poor. I'm done with him. Ask the Admiralty about the fort at Mangrove Key.
Crowe confessed that Grimmer bankrolled his price-fixing.
A shipwright in {p3} came begging for help. Something about a kidnapping. Go and hear her out.
Visit the shipwright in {p3}.
They took my brother. He drew the only true chart of Grimmer's anchorage. A pirate brig is holding him off {p4}. Bring him home and the chart is yours.
Defeat the pirate brig waiting off {p4}.
Your passenger has been scribbling all night. He says Grimmer's lair is at Blackwater Cay, and that the Commodore sails a stolen Admiralty frigate.
steps.ok: Then we'll need a bigger ship.

steps.text: Grimmer hides at Blackwater Cay. Every fine good is now open to trade.
Lieutenant Ada Hale, Admiralty. Grimmer's men hold the old fort at Mangrove Key. Before I commit the fleet I need proof you can fight. Sink three of his raiders.
Sink 3 raider ships for Lieutenant Hale.
Good shooting. The fort's guns cover the whole lagoon. Hit it with everything you have, and bring powder kegs if you can afford them.
Silence the pirate fort at Mangrove Key.
The lagoon is ours. Take this warrant. Report to the governor of {p7}; they have news of Grimmer.
Report to the governor of {p7}.
The Mangrove fort has fallen. The Admiralty is watching you closely now.
Grimmer's captains signal each other with flags. A smuggler named Nell Varga claims to have his signal book. She wants tobacco, delivered to Blackwater Cay, no questions asked.
Smuggle 30 Tobacco to Blackwater Cay for Nell Varga.
Prompt, and nobody followed you. I like you, captain. The signal book is with my partner in {p8}. Mind Grimmer's wolves on the way: they know you're coming now.
Win 2 battles against Grimmer's wolves.
Collect the signal book from Varga's partner in {p8}.
With Grimmer's signal book, you'll know his ships' next move.
